threshold_map.VALID: A meaning-preserving threshold relation is declared.
threshold_map.INVALID: A declared translation fails to preserve required threshold semantics.

witness_invariance.signature: BridgeVerdictInvariant_x(o_i, o_j; epsilon_src, epsilon_obs, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
witness_invariance.definition: There exists v in {PAIR_PASS, PAIR_FAIL} such that every permitted witness for the ordered pair returns v.
requirements: At least one permitted witness exists.
All permitted witnesses produce the same final pair verdict.
witness_invariance.variance_result: Any PASS/FAIL or defined/undefined disagreement yields UNDEFINED_WITNESS_VARIANCE.

binary_evaluator.signature: EvalBCon_FCI005Distinction_x(o_i, o_j; epsilon_src, epsilon_obs, B_x, D_rel, R) : BinaryConstraintResult_x
binary_evaluator.COMPATIBLE: At least one permitted witness exists, BridgeVerdictInvariant_x holds, and the invariant verdict is PAIR_PASS.
binary_evaluator.INCOMPATIBLE: At least one permitted witness exists, BridgeVerdictInvariant_x holds, and the invariant verdict is PAIR_FAIL.
binary_evaluator.UNDEFINED: No permitted witness exists, any required bridge or translation is undefined, any witness is undefined, or permitted witnesses disagree.

pairwise_aggregation.signature: EvalPairwiseCompatible_x(F_x; BCon_x, B_x, D_rel, R) : BinaryConstraintResult_x
pairwise_aggregation.COMPATIBLE: Every applicable binary evaluator returns COMPATIBLE.
pairwise_aggregation.INCOMPATIBLE: At least one applicable binary evaluator returns INCOMPATIBLE.
pairwise_aggregation.UNDEFINED: No evaluator returns INCOMPATIBLE and at least one applicable evaluator returns UNDEFINED.
pairwise_aggregation.guard: The proposition BCon_FCI005Distinction_x is not the sole family-classification input.
